item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2023 evidence that Putin refrained from manipulating electoral rules, courts, media, election commissions, security forces, or public resources. The closest counterevidence is merely that formal elections and some limited local competition still existed, but the sources above describe those contests as heavily managed rather than genuinely contestable.","evidence":[{"title":"Russians vote in tightly controlled regional elections","publisher":"Reuters","date":"9 Sep 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russians-vote-in-tightlycontrolled-regional-elections-first-since-war-began-3169837","summary":"Reuters reported that regional and local elections were tightly controlled: strong opposition candidates were blocked, activists were cowed or jailed, and the Kremlin expanded voting practices critics say help falsify results, including multi-day voting and online voting. Public-sector and employer pressure also pushed turnout.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"Russia arrests leader of vote monitoring group three weeks before regional polls","publisher":"Reuters","date":"18 Aug 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/russia-arrests-leader-of-vote-monitoring-group-three-weeks-before-regional-polls/1720660/","summary":"Authorities arrested Golos co-chair Grigory Melkonyants and raided other monitors’ homes shortly before the regional and presidential election cycle, which Reuters said was an attempt to block scrutiny of the vote.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1","3B.8"]},{"title":"Anti-war challenger Duntsova barred from running against Russia’s Putin","publisher":"Reuters","date":"23 Dec 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/anti-war-challenger-duntsova-barred-from-running-against-russias-putin/1898291/","summary":"The Central Election Commission unanimously rejected Yekaterina Duntsova’s candidacy for the 2024 presidential race after she campaigned against the war and for political prisoners, showing the commission clearing the field of a genuine challenger.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"Russia: Freedom in the World 2023 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2023","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2023","summary":"Freedom House says the Kremlin manipulates elections, uses a controlled media environment and subservient judiciary, changes electoral rules to favor preferred candidates, and mandates opaque online voting that raises security and secrecy concerns. It also says public-sector employers pressure workers to vote.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1","3B.8"]},{"title":"Russia: Nations in Transit 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024","summary":"This report on 2023 says electoral integrity worsened because of fraud, intimidation, and the absence of genuine opposition; it also says electronic voting facilitated fraud and local autonomy had eroded. As a weak counterpoint, it notes municipal councils still matter as an opposition training ground and source of exposure, but under a shrinking and controlled space.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]}]}
